name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA API coverage, fixed typed SDK reads, design operations and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover control, schematics, PCB layout, libraries, manufacturing, design review and extensions. Per-method inventory distinguishes public subsets, native equivalents, blocked implementations and omissions. The current reviewed tuple provides pinned calculations, environment/unit methods, extension/editor/shortcut metadata, exact-target PCB layer/loaded-view identity and Line/Arc/Via geometry observations, local sixteen-event historical abandonment, ordinary existing-profile launch and one-shot disposable project/PCB opening. Opening requires an empty registered editor, a selected registered local file, checkpoint-member PCB and retained ordinary launch. Normal opening can migrate storage, replay caches and automatically Save; it is not design-writer or persistence authority. Inspection and observation never replay navigation. Interrupted opening has a retained-owner terminal retirement path, not lost-handle adoption or generic recovery. Layer, identity and geometry observations use a captured native receiver; they do not certify physical stackup, saved membership or connectivity. Geometry contains bounded native DTOs, not public SDK objects. Historical abandonment qualifies retained pre-navigation evidence without process, completion or replay authority. Ordinary launch does not prove isolation or readiness. Missing installation files select offline-only startup. The older tuple retains guarded readers, footprint typed API operations, native controls, checkpoints and recovery. Schematic-page, symbol and PCB transactions plus eight metadata writers remain blocked pending native structure-job completion and complete SQL-effect proof. Compiled topology and affected exports refuse hidden annotation or Save All. Connected validation remains operation- and generation-specific. Arbitrary JavaScript, blind retry and unrestricted Save remain refused; the legacy writer is runtime-disabled. The historical reviewed tuple is connected-read-admitted; future mismatches fail closed within each capability profile.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
